text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Symboli Rudolf, Tokai Teio, and 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi were invited for a 
magazine interview—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If I recall correctly, after the 
photoshoot comes the interview?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The theme for this special feature is 
'The Figure to Chase After'—let us start 
with you, Symboli Rudolf-san.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Your remarkable track record continues as 
always! To the point where one might 
wonder if you even have a 'figure to chase 
after' yourself!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As one who aspires to lead by personal 
example, I have continually strived to 
deliver results worthy of pride.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Going forward, I intend to dedicate myself 
body and soul so that I may always remain 
that very 'figure to chase after.'

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
To be the very figure worth chasing 
yourself, that's Symboli Rudolf-san for 
you! Moving on—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi-san, Tokai Teio-san. 
You two have been the talk of the town 
with your remarkable recent growth, but 
who is 'the figure you chase after'?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that obvious? President Symboli 
Rudolf, of course! Because the Prez is the 
coolest and most amazing horse girl ever!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to be just like the Prez is what 
brought me all the way here!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Me too! Ever since I enrolled, I've 
trained non-stop hoping to become a 
shining horse girl just like President 
Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even with a weak body, the reason I never 
gave up and made it this far is because I 
had President Rudolf as my goal!

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text: Although—right? However—you know?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ? Is something the matter, you two?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm, how should we put this... What do 
you think, Teio-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! There's only one thing to do!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing a commotion at the track, I went 
over to look, finding that Symboli Rudolf 
and the others were about to hold a mock 
race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Man, getting to cover them running too! 
What a lucky day!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Still, why did they go out of their way to 
hold a mock race...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Showing is faster than telling, huh? Yeah, 
that really suits us!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right, right? After all, our true feelings 
have gotta be shown in a race!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Vimalakirti's silence... Indeed, there are 
times when actions speak far louder than 
words.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If so, come—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Kuh! The Prez is incredible after all! 
But—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If I lose focus for even a second, she'll 
pull away...! Even so—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
?! The sheer intensity from those two as 
well... Is this... really the power born 
merely from admiration...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
('The figure to chase after'—no, that's 
not it. What we're looking at isn't just 
the Prez's 'back' anymore—)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Not just chasing... Overtaking, winning, 
and then—)

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Go for it, Teio-chan!! You're the 
strongest, Teio-chan!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru-chan-senpai~! Don't give up, you're 
the one who'll win in the end, Senpai~!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well done... But it is far from 
over—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the crowd erupted over the magnificent 
race, someone who appeared to be a 
reporter could be heard murmuring in awe 
at the three runners.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... What a gross misunderstanding I 
had...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Losing is not an option—with unshakable 
conviction, each of them believes 
wholeheartedly in herself...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
This is no mere 'figure to chase after.' I 
have to change it. The title for this 
article should be... yes. 'Standing Side 
by Side'—
